title: Release startup and idle memory
description: Launch the release application into its default shell, observe first-frame and first-interactive milestones, then measure idle memory after the common warm-up.

slint.notes: All browser/chart controllers and quant views are constructed eagerly in the audited implementation.

qml.notes: Page components are declared in the shell; lazy-loading policy requires verification.

bevy-egui.notes: All four 3-D scenes and broad UI state initialize globally in the audited implementation.

fixture.notes: Draft only: default generated application state has not been normalized.

actions.input: Start the process with the normalized viewport and no scenario-specific page override.
actions.expected: The default browser shell is rendered and reaches a documented interactive condition without an error.

deviations: Draft: initialization scope and default geometry differ in the audited applications.
Historical best-of-three startup values are not inputs to this controlled scenario.
